name: cerco-pruebas
description: Pruebas automáticas de CERCO (no forma parte de la web)

scripts.test: npm run preparar && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-cerco --only auth,firestore "npm run test:reglas && npm run test:web"
scripts.capturas:nuevas: npm run preparar && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-cerco --only auth,firestore "playwright test --update-snapshots"
scripts.emulador: npm run preparar && firebase emulators:start --project demo-cerco --only auth,firestore
